series_start_reason: Series starts 2020Q3, the U.S. launch quarter, read from the prior-year column of the third-quarter 2021 release (9) because the third-quarter 2020 release carries Tecartus inside 'Other' (footnote '(5) Includes Cayston, Hepsera, Sovaldi and Tecartus.'). The prior-year nine-months column (10) and the second-quarter 2021 release's prior-year Europe column (1) show 1 of European sales before 2020Q3; no filing prints that as a Tecartus quarter.
search_log: Listed every Gilead Sciences (CIK 882095) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (all forms); earnings releases are the 8-K/8-K/A filings with item 2.02 from 2009, each exhibit resolved from index.json; plus every 10-Q and 10-K from 2009.

Every table row whose first cell starts with Cayston, Tecartus, Veklury, Zydelig or Yeztugo followed by a figure was extracted from all of those documents (scan.py); for a product printed as regional lines ('<product> – U.S.', '– Europe', '– Other International' / 'Rest of World', or from 2026 '<product> | U.S.' then 'Europe', 'Rest of World'), the figure is the unlabelled worldwide total line beneath them, never a sum computed here.
Each quarter is read from the release that reports it as current (filed in the month after quarter end; Q4 in January/February).

Tecartus rows: unlabelled total beneath 'Tecartus – U.S./Europe/Other International (Rest of World)' for 2020Q4-2025Q4; from 2026 the release prints 'Tecartus | U.S.', 'Europe', 'Rest of World' and an unlabelled total (equal to the Forms 10-Q for 2026Q1 and 2026Q2: 75 and 70).

Four-quarter sums 2021-2025: 176, 299, 371, 403, 343 against printed twelve-month figures 176, 299, 370, 403, 344. 2020: 9 + 34 = 43 against the printed twelve months 44 (includes the 1 before 2020Q3).
